attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: progress_photo_upload
steps:
  - id: step_receive_upload
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/photos/upload"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_upload

  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_validate_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_upload
      schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - image
          - date
          - user_id
        properties:
          image:
            type: string
            format: binary
            max_size_mb: 10
            allowed_formats:
              - "image/jpeg"
              - "image/png"
              - "image/webp"
          date:
            type: string
            format: date
          notes:
            type: string
            maxLength: 500
          user_id:
            type: string
    output: validated_upload

  - id: step_extract_image
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_upload
      field: "image"
    output: image_data

  - id: step_encrypt_image
    op: encrypt_field
    params:
      input: image_data
      algorithm: "AES-256"
      scope: "private"
    output: encrypted_image

  - id: step_extract_metadata
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_upload
      mapping:
        user_id: "$.user_id"
        date: "$.date"
        notes: "$.notes"
        visibility: "private"
        encrypted_image: "$.encrypted_image_ref"
    output: photo_record

  - id: step_merge_photo_record
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: photo_record
      secondary: encrypted_image
      key: "user_id"
    output: complete_record

  - id: step_write_photo
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: complete_record
      table: "user_progress_photos"
      access_control: "owner_only"
    output: write_result

  - id: step_audit_log
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: photo_record
      action: "progress_photo_uploaded"
      details:
        visibility: "private"
        user_id: "$.user_id"
        date: "$.date"

  - id: step_notify_user
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: photo_record
      message: "Your progress photo has been securely uploaded."
      channel: "in_app"

  - id: step_handle_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: "step_receive_upload"
      action: "step_error_terminate"

  - id: step_error_terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failed"
      message: "Progress photo upload failed. Please try again."
